verdict.rationale: Docs claim AvaTax applies consistent tax logic across ecommerce, marketplace, POS, and ERP systems (avalara-docs-20) and provide REST/SDKs for common languages, implying broad platform compatibility, but the evidence pack contains no list of maintained, pre-built connectors for specific billing systems, payment processors, or commerce platforms (e.g., Stripe, Shopify, QuickBooks) — only generic language SDKs and raw transaction APIs that a developer must wire up themselves. missing for 10: named/maintained platform-specific integrations, evidence of a partner/integrations marketplace, independent confirmation these connectors are actively maintained.
